title: Ren's Mod Additions
description: Adds some quality of life and automation options to some mods!
body:
Ever thought that some mods were lacking?
Well worry no more! As this mod helps you in a bunch of ways!
Need to automate naquadah? Download this mod and you'll be swimming in it!

So far the only thing it offers is Naquadah Automation via the Create Mod. More will be added in the future!
